The Euler characteristic and signature of M are, respectively, χ = 2 + n+ + n−, τ = n+ − n−. Then 8π2 χ = 6 Vol(M) 1 + E(v2 + b2 )  , 12π2 τ = 6 Vol(M) E(v2 − b2 ).
